content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left) build similar muscle across a wide range, from roughly 5 to 30 reps. Lighter loads work as long as the effort is high.

💡 Your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, though, so you do need heavy work. Strength is specific, so you have to practice heavy low-rep sets (around 3-6 reps) on the bench. A mix of heavy work and moderate 8-12 rep sets gives you both.
